propositions: Signed verdicts must record provider, tier, endpoint host, and effective capabilities alongside the existing model string, to distinguish between first-class and best-effort provider backends.
The provider_provenance object must be assembled once in runner.py from already-resolved data and reused, never recomputed, to preserve the capability record that actually drove the run.
The endpoint_host field must extract only the hostname via urlparse().hostname, never netloc, to exclude credentials from the persisted signed payload.

All three sidecar writers (plan-review, completion, code-review) must thread the provider_provenance record from the finalized verdict into their payloads, and it must reach the verdict object before build_payload is called.
The addition must be backward-compatible and additive-only: existing readers ignore the absent key in legacy payloads, and no migration or compatibility gate is required.
A test must verify that no credential material from base_url or api_key appears anywhere in the persisted sidecar payload, and that legacy payloads without provider_provenance still load and verify.
